Madras is a beautiful, historic, and characteristic summer fabric. Usually you’d see it in bright, poppy colors and, while beautiful, we usually like to tone that down and give note to more faded and worn tones. What makes ours even more special, though, is its handmade qualities. The cotton is hand-spun into the yarns, which are hand-woven into this fabric.
Our madras reflects a lot of the natural shades from the landscape in New Mexico. We used unbleached and undyed yarns where we could, and tried to use minimally processed dyes for the browns and tan colors in there as well. They sit very well with the other colors of the collection - and why shouldn’t they? Everything is pulled from the beauty naturally found out there.
We took the rodeo plaid found in our Fall/Winter flannels and applied the earthtones onto the madras.

The Folgate—a sleek, contemporary take on the classic ’60s-style square frame designs.  BOLD London is a boutique eyewear brand born from a passion for crafting exquisite, impeccably constructed frames using the finest materials and time-honoured British artisanal techniques. Each pair is meticulously sculpted by hand from premium cellulose acetate. First, the raw shape is cut from a block, then filed into shape before heat is applied to manipulate the curvature. The frames are then buffed and polished by hand before undergoing an intensive tumbling process—for up to 48 hours—to achieve a flawlessly smooth, even finish.
Built for durability and distinction, one of BOLD’s signature design elements is the extra thickness in the front and sides of the frame, enhancing strength while remaining lightweight. This model is constructed using robust 7-barrel rivet hinges and fitted with Carl Zeiss dark grey gradient lenses, offering style and superior optical performance.
